Album.why: One row per album keyed by AlbumId, pointing at Artist; Track points at it.

Artist.why: 275 recording artists keyed by ArtistId with only a name; Album points at it. An open set of real performers rather than a code list, so an entity, not a reference.

Customer.why: One row per customer keyed by CustomerId with name, address and contact details; Invoice points at it.

Employee.why: Eight staff keyed by EmployeeId with names, addresses and hire dates (business dates); Customer points at it and ReportsTo is a self-reference.

Genre.why: 25 genre names keyed by GenreId, pointed at only by Track.

Invoice.why: One row per sale, stamped with InvoiceDate; CustomerId repeats across invoices.

InvoiceLine.why: Lines of an invoice, one per track bought, pointing at Invoice and Track; a line item, so an event whose time sits on Invoice.

MediaType.why: Five media-type names keyed by MediaTypeId, pointed at only by Track.

Playlist.why: 18 named playlists keyed by PlaylistId, the collection side of the PlaylistTrack bridge; a thing tracks belong to rather than a label on a code.

PlaylistTrack.why: Pure link of PlaylistId and TrackId, both pointers, keyed by the pair.

Track.why: One row per track keyed by TrackId, pointing at Album, Genre and MediaType; InvoiceLine and PlaylistTrack point at it.
